finding_summary: WP802-WP805 expose stronger typed evaluator-origin native results than WP807 currently consumes.
WP802 binds terminal/cumulative score/actions and derives matched score_delta from exact episode results.
WP803 enforces benchmark_score_delta from CORRECT/INCORRECT/ABSTAINED outcome.
WP804 produces evaluator-origin correctness against a sealed exact label/inference lineage.
WP805 binds terminal/final evaluator score/actions/replayed work and derives matched efficiency deltas.
WP807 instead accepts generic PPM/sample/success/action scalars without consuming those native result objects or binding a canonical conversion identity.
Its current unit-test helper constructs the generic numbers directly, so the proposed upstream score-success invariant is not established at the WP807 boundary.
architecture_delta: Add producer-specific deterministic adapters or cryptographically bound derivation receipts from exact WP802-WP805 native results to WP807 CapabilityEvidence. Unsupported/free-form scalar evidence must be NOT_EVALUABLE. Do not flatten heterogeneous native metrics into an unexplained common intelligence score.
next_exact_action: Trigger 4 active WP807 owner: implement the smallest derivation boundary and negative controls for score tampering, false goal correctness, false terminal success and inconsistent matched deltas; preserve current component-only authority and separate integrated-trajectory gate.
mirror_policy: Provenance mirror only. F2 owns canonical claim/result authority.
